mapper.select: select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where o.is_delete = 0 and o.order_status in (10, 15, 45, 60, 65)
select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c where c.is_delete = 0 and c.case_status = 0
select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.is_delete = 0 and l.abnormal_flag = 1 and l.route_status not in (2, 4)
select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event e where e.is_delete = 0 and e.alert_status = 0

select o.order_id as task_id, 6 as task_type, case when o.order_status in (60, 65) then 3 else 2 end as priority, o.order_status as task_status, concat('订单履约：', o.order_no) as subject, case o.order_status when 10 then '订单等待发货' when 15 then '订单已备货，等待发出' when 45 then '订单归还中，等待验机完成' when 60 then '订单归还已逾期' when 65 then '订单已逾期，需要平台关注' else '订单需要跟进' end as detail, o.order_no as business_no, as merchant_name, date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(coalesce(o.update_time, o.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from ry_business.ry_rental_order o left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and m.member_id = o.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where o.is_delete = 0 and o.order_status in (10, 15, 45, 60, 65) order by priority desc, o.update_time asc, o.order_id asc limit #{limit}

select c.case_id as task_id, 7 as task_type, 3 as priority, c.case_status as task_status, concat('售后处理：', c.case_no) as subject, coalesce(nullif(c.problem_desc, ''), '售后案件等待平台处理') as detail, c.case_no as business_no, as merchant_name, date_format(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(coalesce(c.update_time, c.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from ry_business.ry_rental_after_sales_case c left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and m.member_id = c.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where c.is_delete = 0 and c.case_status = 0 order by c.create_time asc, c.case_id asc limit #{limit}

select l.logistics_id as task_id, 8 as task_type, 3 as priority, l.route_status as task_status, concat('物流异常：', coalesce(nullif(l.tracking_no, ''), '未填写单号')) as subject, coalesce(nullif(l.route_message, ''), concat(coalesce(l.carrier, '未知承运商'), ' 运单需要处理')) as detail, l.tracking_no as business_no, as merchant_name, date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(coalesce(l.update_time, l.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and m.member_id = l.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where l.is_delete = 0 and l.abnormal_flag = 1 and l.route_status not in (2, 4) order by l.update_time asc, l.logistics_id asc limit #{limit}

select e.alert_id as task_id, 9 as task_type, 2 as priority, e.alert_status as task_status, concat('库存告警：', coalesce(nullif(p.product_name, ''), p.product_code, '未知商品')) as subject, e.alert_message as detail, p.product_code as business_no, m.member_code as merchant_code, as merchant_name, date_format(e.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, date_format(coalesce(e.update_time, e.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from ry_business.ry_rental_inventory_alert_event e left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and p.member_id = e.member_id and p.product_id = e.product_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_rental.ry_rental_member m on m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and m.member_id = e.member_id and m.is_delete = 0 where e.is_delete = 0 and e.alert_status = 0 order by e.last_triggered_time asc, e.alert_id asc limit #{limit}
